mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.employee_id AS employeeId, o.id AS orgId, o.org_name AS orgName, o.org_type AS orgType, uo.org_role AS orgRole, uo.is_primary AS isPrimary FROM t_user u JOIN t_user_org uo ON u.id = uo.user_id JOIN t_org o ON uo.org_id = o.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND o.org_type = #{classes} AND uo.is_primary = 0 AND o.status = 1 LIMIT 1
